currentAgentPrerequisite.scope: New current-host inputs after accounting corrections, separate from frozen historical D9 replay. No mask/status/cache intervention. Failed inputs or within-backend variation stop full qualification, not selective reruns.

upgradeComparison.pilot: One warmup and one measured job per workload/backend before full cohort; diagnostics cannot qualify timing.
upgradeComparison.finalOriginalComparison: Same gates against frozen original preview on common successful jobs; no compounded phase allowances.

contextScreen.intermediateCondition: Only if 24 GiB is inadmissible; one preregistered follow-up, no budget search.
contextScreen.256K: Excluded unless useful simultaneous evidence exceeds 128K after retrieval.

precision: Explicit BF16 first; automatic M5 activation is a separate candidate with the same behavioral gates.
failurePolicy: Retain all attempts, warmups, oracles and source/binary/configuration identities. Diagnose an actual defect before a revised candidate retry. No relaxed parity, post-hoc exclusions or full-cohort loop until green. A failed qualification retains the previous runtime/profile. Current installed preview is not a production-qualified fallback.
